title: The Rain-Fed Growth Canon
summary: A canon that joins wood qi to water qi so that growth feeds on the downpour and the downpour on growth.

title: Canon of the Burning Bough
summary: A canon that sets the living bough alight with fire qi and keeps it growing as it burns.

title: The Deep Life Canon of Timber
summary: A canon that joins wood qi to the deeper qi of life so that every limb of the tree is a living thing that mends and strikes.

title: A Manual of Stone-Rooted Growth
summary: A manual that joins wood qi to earth qi so roots split stone and stone holds the tree upright.
